landing.title: Compliance + trust in a single line of code
landing.subtitle: Scan your store for EU AI Act violations and install a trust widget that converts visitors into buyers.

features.title: Two problems. One widget.
features.complianceBody: Our AI scans your storefront, detects unlabeled AI-generated content, missing watermarks, opaque pricing algorithms, and gives you an audit-ready report.
features.trustBody: A stylish trust badge with verified reviews, transparency labels, and an AI assistant that answers buyer questions in real time.
features.installBody: One line of JavaScript. No SDK, no plugin, no developer meeting. Works on Shopify, WooCommerce, custom stacks.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Paste your storefront URL. We validate the domain.
how.step2Body: Gemini analyzes pages against the EU AI Act checklist and returns a compliance score with findings.
how.step3Body: Copy one line of code. Configure colors and position from your dashboard.

landing.footNote: Not legal advice. TrustSeal helps you prepare for compliance reviews; final decisions rest with you and your counsel.

about.title: Why TrustSeal
about.body1: In August 2026 the EU AI Act's core obligations kick in. Any online store that uses AI to personalize prices, generate product images, run recommendation engines, or reply with a chatbot must label those systems, disclose training data provenance, and maintain risk documentation.
about.body2: At the same time, buyers are more skeptical than ever. Reviews are gamed. Photos are AI-generated. Stores lose 60–70% of visitors at the checkout because trust never crossed the finish line.
about.body3: TrustSeal solves both sides with one product: an AI compliance scanner for the operator, and a customer-facing trust widget that turns transparency into conversion.
